name: cniska-task
description: Keeps a running agent-task brief from changing under its task: before each Edit, Write or MultiEdit it denies an edit to a running task's brief, naming drop, the edit and start under a new name; and when a session starts, resumes, clears or compacts in a directory holding a running task's brief, it puts the running tasks in the session's context as agent-task list prints them. It needs the agent-task CLI on PATH and does nothing without it.
